arxiv-2302-06087.title: Dynamic Simulation of Splashing Fluids
arxiv-2302-06087.creator: James F. O’Brien, Jessica K. Hodgins
arxiv-2302-06087.description: Abstract Abstract: In this paper we describe a method for modeling the dynamic behavior of splashing fluids. The model simulates the behavior of a fluid when objects impact or float on its surface. The forces generated by the objects create waves and splashes on the surface of the fluid.

arxiv-2408-05537.title: S-SIRUS: an explainability algorithm for spatial regression Random Forest
arxiv-2408-05537.creator: Luca Patelli, Natalia Golini, Rosaria Ignaccolo, Michela Cameletti
arxiv-2408-05537.description: Abstract Random Forest (RF) is a widely used machine learning algorithm known for its flexibility, user-friendliness, and high predictive performance across various domains. However, it is non-interpretable. This can limit its usefulness in applied sciences, where understanding the relationships between predictors and response variable is crucial from a decision-making perspective.

arxiv-2409-01217.title: A multilingual training strategy for low resource Text to Speech
arxiv-2409-01217.creator: Asma Amalas, Mounir Ghogho, Mohamed Chetouani, Rachid Oulad Haj Thami
arxiv-2409-01217.description: Abstract Recent speech technologies have led to produce high quality synthesised speech due to recent advances in neural Text to Speech (TTS). However, such TTS models depend on extensive amounts of data that can be costly to produce and is hardly scalable to all existing languages, especially that seldom attention is given to low resource languages.

arxiv-2409-13939.title: Simple Unsupervised Knowledge Distillation With Space Similarity
arxiv-2409-13939.creator: Aditya Singh, Haohan Wang
arxiv-2409-13939.description: Abstract As per recent studies, Self-supervised learning (SSL) does not readily extend to smaller architectures. One direction to mitigate this shortcoming while simultaneously training a smaller network without labels is to adopt unsupervised knowledge distillation (UKD). Existing UKD approaches handcraft preservation worthy inter/intra sample relationships between the teacher and its student.

arxiv-2410-02984.title: Differentiation and Specialization of Attention Heads via the Refined Local Learning Coefficient
arxiv-2410-02984.creator: George WangTimaeus, Jesse HooglandTimaeus, Stan van WingerdenTimaeus, Zach FurmanTimaeus, Daniel MurfetSchool of Mathematics and StatisticsThe University of Melbourne
arxiv-2410-02984.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by George WangTimaeus, Jesse HooglandTimaeus, Stan van WingerdenTimaeus, Zach FurmanTimaeus, Daniel MurfetSchool of Mathematics and StatisticsThe University of Melbourne. We introduce refined variants of the Local Learning Coefficient (LLC), a measure of model complexity grounded in singular learning theory, to study the development of internal structure in transformer language models during training. By applying these refined LLCs (rLLCs) to individual components of a two-layer attention-only transformer, we gain novel insights into the progressive differentiation and specialization of attention heads.

arxiv-2506-09215.title: Robust Noise Attenuation via Adaptive Pooling of Transformer Outputs
arxiv-2506-09215.creator: Greyson Brothers
arxiv-2506-09215.description: Abstract We investigate the design of pooling methods used to summarize the outputs of transformer embedding models, primarily motivated by reinforcement learning and vision applications. This work considers problems where a subset of the input vectors contains requisite information for a downstream task (signal) while the rest are distractors (noise).

arxiv-2506-15878.title: Flavor-Dependent Entanglement Entropy in the Veneziano Limit from Light-Front Holographic QCD
arxiv-2506-15878.creator: Fidele J. Twagirayezu
arxiv-2506-15878.description: Abstract We introduce a novel application of light-front holographic QCD (LFHQCD) to compute the flavor-dependent entanglement entropy of QCD subsystems in the Veneziano limit ( N c , N f → ∞ N_{c},N_{f}\to\infty , λ = N f / N c \lambda=N_{f}/N_{c} fixed), probing quantum correlations in confined and quark-gluon plasma (QGP) phases.

arxiv-2508-16929.title: Attention Layers Add Into Low-Dimensional Residual Subspaces
arxiv-2508-16929.creator: Junxuan WangXuyang GeWentao ShuZhengfu HeXipeng Qiu
arxiv-2508-16929.description: Abstract While transformer models are widely believed to operate in high-dimensional hidden spaces, we show that attention outputs are confined to a surprisingly low-dimensional subspace, where about 60% of the directions account for 99% of the variance–a phenomenon that is induced by the attention output projection matrix and consistently observed across diverse model families and datasets.

arxiv-2511-01303.title: Black-Box Differentially Private Nonparametric Confidence Intervals Under Minimal Assumptions
arxiv-2511-01303.creator: Tomer Shoham, Moshe Shenfeld, Noa Velner-Harris, Katrina Ligett
arxiv-2511-01303.description: Abstract We introduce a simple, general framework that takes any differentially private estimator of any arbitrary quantity as a black box, and from it constructs a differentially private nonparametric confidence interval of that quantity. Our approach repeatedly subsamples the data, applies the private estimator to each subsample, and then post-processes the resulting empirical CDF to a confidence interval.

arxiv-2511-07491.title: Quantifying the Impact of CU: A Systematic Literature Review
arxiv-2511-07491.creator: Thomas Compton
arxiv-2511-07491.description: Abstract 1 abstract Community Unionism (CU) has served as a pivotal concept in debates on trade union renewal since the early 2000s, yet its theoretical coherence and political significance remain unresolved. This article investigates why CU has gained such prominence—not by testing its efficacy, but by mapping how it is constructed, cited, and contested across the scholarly literature.

pmc-10512556.title: Elucidating the molecular mechanisms underlying the induction of autophagy by antidepressant-like substances in C57BL/6J mouse testis model upon LPS challenge
pmc-10512556.creator: Przemysław Sołek, Ewelina Czechowska, Magdalena Sowa-Kućma, Katarzyna Stachowicz, Piotr Kaczka, Anna Tabęcka-Łonczyńska
pmc-10512556.description: The treatment of depression with pharmaceuticals is associated with many adverse side effects, including male fertility problems. The precise mechanisms by which these agents affect testicular cells remain largely unknown, but they are believed to induce cellular stress, which is sensed by the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and the Golgi apparatus.

pmc-11496921.title: The Role of Relevance in Shaping Perceptions of Sleep Hygiene Games Among University Students: Mixed Methods Study
pmc-11496921.creator: Zilu Liang, Edward Melcer, Kingkarn Khotchasing, Samantha Chen, Daeun Hwang, Nhung Huyen Hoang
pmc-11496921.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundSleep games are an emerging topic in the realm of serious health game research. However, designing features that are both enjoyable and effective at engaging users, particularly university students, to develop healthy sleep habits remains a challenge.ObjectiveThis study aims to investigate user preferences for 3 sleep game prototypes, that is, Hero’s Sleep Journey, Sleep Tamagotchi, and Sleepland, and to explore their popularity and perceived utility in promoting sleep health.MethodsA mixed methods approach was used in this study.

pmc-11499807.title: Targeting CD93 on monocytes revitalizes antitumor immunity by enhancing the function and infiltration of CD8+ T cells
pmc-11499807.creator: Da Jiang, Aiqi Huang, Bai-Xi Zhu, Jiangling Gong, Yong-Hao Ruan, Xing-Chen Liu, Limin Zheng, Yan Wu
pmc-11499807.description: BackgroundLimited activation and infiltration of CD8+ T cells are major challenges facing T cell-based immunotherapy for most solid tumors, of which the mechanism is multilayered and not yet fully understood.MethodsLevels of CD93 expression on monocytes from paired non-tumor, peritumor and tumor tissues of human hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) were evaluated.

pmc-11520189.title: Metabolite profiling and transcriptome analyses reveal defense regulatory network against pink tea mite invasion in tea plant
pmc-11520189.creator: Limin Chen, Zaifa Shu, Dayun Zhou, Huijuan Zhou, Jinchao Wang, Yaqi Feng, Shenghong Zheng, Weizhong He
pmc-11520189.description: BackgroundThe tea plant Camellia sinensis (L.) O. Kuntze is a perennial crop, invaded by diversity of insect pest species, and pink tea mite is one of the most devastating pests for sustainable tea production. However, molecular mechanism of defense responses against pink tea mites in tea is still unknown.

pmc-11645435.title: FastTENET: an accelerated TENET algorithm based on manycore computing in Python
pmc-11645435.creator: Rakbin Sung, Hyeonkyu Kim, Junil Kim, Daewon Lee, Can Alkan
pmc-11645435.description: SummaryTENET reconstructs gene regulatory networks from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNAseq) data using the transfer entropy (TE), and works successfully on a variety of scRNAseq data. However, TENET is limited by its long computation time for large datasets. To address this limitation, we propose FastTENET, an array-computing version of TENET algorithm optimized for acceleration on manycore processors such as GPUs.

pmc-12431626.title: Fabrication of Thixotropic Polymeric Gel System and Its Gelation Mechanism
pmc-12431626.creator: Zhilei Zhang, Yuan Geng, Ren Wang, Zhiyuan Yan, Minghao Sun, Sicong Meng, Yan Zhang, Hong Yang, Yaoxuan Li, Yuecheng Zhu
pmc-12431626.description: To address the issues of traditional gels in high-temperature reservoir leakage plugging, such as injection–retention imbalance, poor high-temperature stability, and insufficient thixotropy, this study developed a thixotropic polymer gel system via molecular design and component optimization, aiming to achieve excellent thixotropy, high strength, and wide temperature adaptability (80–140 °C) while clarifying its gelation mechanism.

pmc-12647593.title: Predictive maintenance programs for aircraft engines based on remaining useful life prediction
pmc-12647593.creator: Fei Xue, Guodong Jin, Lining Tan, Chengxi Zhang, Ye Yu
pmc-12647593.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The remaining useful life (RUL) and utilization strategy of an aero-engine are related to the flight safety of an aircraft, which directly affects the flight itself and the safety of the occupants. Aiming at the complexity of aero-engine condition monitoring data, an aero-engine predictive maintenance planning framework based on RUL prediction is proposed, which aims to analyze the engine RUL and design predictive maintenance strategies.

pmc-13274046.title: Efficacy and safety of standalone middle meningeal artery embolization for chronic subdural hematoma: a single-center retrospective cohort study
pmc-13274046.creator: Dajiang Xie
pmc-13274046.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13344231.title: The taper sign: Sonographic representation of uterine dehiscence in severe cases of placenta accreta spectrum
pmc-13344231.creator: Uma Deshmukh, Anna M Modest, Alfred Abuhamad, Alireza A Shamshirsaz, Jonathan L Hecht, Scott A Shainker
pmc-13344231.description: IntroductionPrenatal diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) depends on reliable ultrasound markers and skilled image interpretation. Existing PAS markers emphasize placental features suggestive of abnormal adherence and require advanced image optimization. However, emerging hypotheses suggest that uterine dehiscence—not placental invasion—is the central mechanism underlying PAS, particularly in severe (Grade 3) disease.

pmc-13412282.creator: Anna Paola Minervini, Silvia Procino, Anna Maria Pellegrini, Alberto Reddavide, Domenico De Paola, Giacomo Mangini, Nunzio D’Agostino, Francesca Taranto
pmc-13412282.description: Polyphenol oxidase (PPO) activity is a key determinant of wheat quality, influencing enzymatic browning of end products while also contributing to biochemical defence against (a)biotic stresses. In this review, we present a comprehensive structural characterization of more than 25 distinct alleles across the Ppo-1 and Ppo-2 gene families, revealing extensive allelic diversity between bread wheat (Triticum aestivum L.

pmc-13447473.title: Circular RNA circTrpc6-induced tau phosphorylation contributes to neuronal injury and cognitive decline via miR-485-5p/eIF4E axis in senescence-accelerated mouse prone 8 mice
pmc-13447473.creator: Jin-Lan Huang, Qiu-Qing Yan, Yan-Bin Guo, Yu-Xuan Du, Ling-Ling Liu, Xiao-Jing Sun, Chao Yu, Deng-Pan Wu
pmc-13447473.description: Tau hyperphosphorylation, a key neuropathological feature in neurodegenerative disorders, is strongly linked to cognitive decline. CircRNAs are recognized to play a crucial regulatory role in numerous human diseases, yet their impacts on neurodegenerative diseases remain unclear. This study was aimed to characterize and analyze the contribution of circTrpc6 to neurodegeneration and its molecular mechanisms.
